title: Census Maps
text: Each shape on this map of Sarasota County, Florida represents a census tract. Darker colors indicate a larger share of residents under age 18, based on the 2024 American Community Survey 5-year estimates from the U.S. Census Bureau. Hover over any tract to see its exact percentage of children.
